mappings.note: Why the Parsis left Persia - persecution, forced conversion, destruction of fire temples. Migration history, goal-level CG-SST2.
The sugar-in-milk legend as a promise to sweeten without displacing. LO-83 for the settlement-without-displacement principle, CG-SST2 for the legend as the community's founding account.

Zoroastrianism and Vedic thought sharing a supreme cosmic order and the centrality of fire. Kinship between two religious traditions, LO-81; the Avestan-Sanskrit items carry CG-SST2 because those turn on language.
Arab merchants arriving on the west coast from the 7th century, trading spices and marrying locally. Migration and settlement, goal-level CG-SST2.
Siddis brought as enslaved people by Arab, Portuguese and British traders. Forced migration, goal-level CG-SST2.
Siddi identity today - African drumming and dance with Indian languages and faiths. Cultural fusion, goal-level CG-SST2; LO-84 is reserved for the items about their economic standing.
Armenians settling under Akbar's patronage, free to build churches. Migration and royal welcome, goal-level CG-SST2.

Armenian roles in the Mughal household, army and administration. A community's place in an earlier polity, goal-level CG-SST2. (The stored answer breaks off and runs into Syriac Christian text; see report.)

This row's stem is two questions run together; the scored content is the case study its answer resolves - Syriac worship, Persian suspicion of Roman sympathy, and the maritime routes that carried them to Kerala. Migration history and its causes, goal-level CG-SST2. (Merged stem; see report.)
Case study on the full jug of milk and the spoonful of sugar at Sanjan. CG-SST2 for the arrival and its account, LO-83 for the settlement-as-enrichment claim that part (c) asks students to explain.
Case study on the Polish orphans, Nawanagar in modern Gujarat, and the Warsaw memorial. Historical event and its commemoration, goal-level CG-SST2.
Case study on the 1959 flight from Lhasa, asylum, and the monasteries at Dharamshala. CG-SST2 for the event, LO-83 for part (c), which asks how those institutions let a minority keep its identity.

Case study on Siddi origins, settlement in Gujarat and Karnataka, and Hirabai Lobi's Padma Shri for teaching organic farming and building livelihoods. CG-SST2 for the history, LO-84 because part (c) turns on economic uplift of a disadvantaged community.
